audit_comment: APPENDIX 3: THE CLERICAL QUICK-REFERENCE CHARTS, BATCH TWO - the D&DG walk round twenty-two, print pp. 136-137: the second batch of deity rows - Central American (12), Chinese (15), Cthulhu (8) - riding the roster data file, the Cthulhu tail on the next pdf page head; the App 3 gap box stays open until the last chart batch lands. The print voice is the ROTATED tesseract pass, collated against the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows. The headline divergence: the print reads sky blue for the Hastur raiment color where the L&L voice reads yellow-orange - pinned by print, eyeball flag.

banner.title: Appendix 3: the clerical quick-reference chart, batch two - the D&DG walk round twenty-two, print pp. 136-137: the 35 rows of the Central American, Chinese and Cthulhu pantheons across the 13 printed columns.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the ROTATED extract/ddg tesseract pass (pNNN_rot_full.txt + pNNN_rot_tsv.tsv, pdf pages 136-138; the second printing) - the Cthulhu block spills onto pdf p138 head (Ithaqua, Nyarlathotep, Shub-Niggurath, Yog-Sothoth); the collation voice: the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows (the flafp.htm slug for Fei Lien and Feng Po, the nocha.htm slug for No Cha). The adjudications: the Hastur sky blue color (print over the L&L yellow-orange, eyeball flag), the gray spellings of the print pinned over the L&L grey, the L&L <sea caves> gloss on the Cthulhu place a 5th-print addition, the chart-print Cthuga garble (the R856 walk pins Cthugha), the ! glyph name garbles (Huehueteotl, Tlazolteotl), the FeiLien space restored, and the semicolon spheres (both voices agree). The batch order runs Central American, Chinese, Cthulhu.
